task: Add native .xlsb ingestion and extraction parity with .xlsx across File Data Source ingestion, chat file attachments, and Azure DevOps work-item/wiki attachment loading.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches 7 distinct components (IndexKnowledgeBaseFileTypes enum, LOADERS dict, xlsx_workers dispatch, XlsxTool, MimeType, ADO work-item loader, ADO wiki loader) spanning 3 subsystems — File Data Source ingestion, chat-attachment XlsxTool, and Azure DevOps loaders — plus the shared core MimeType.is_excel utility. Predicted surface spans 8 modified source files (pyproject.toml, file_object.py, index.py, file_extraction_utils.py, xlsx_workers.py, tools.py, azure_devops_work_item_loader.py, azure_devops_wiki_loader.py) plus updates across 7 existing xlsx test suites, touching 5+ directories (rest_api/models, datasource/loader, file_analysis/workers, file_analysis/xlsx, base, tests).

Touches Workflow (File Data Source ingestion pipeline), Service (xlsx_workers.py / XlsxProcessor core parsing), Agent-Tool (XlsxTool chat attachments), and External (Azure DevOps work-item and wiki attachment loaders).
